author: GameTrailers
description: Here's a look at the Vault Breaker Gameplay Overview Trailer for Marathon, the hit first-person sci-fi extraction shooter developed by Bungie. Players can get the gameplay overview of Marathon's first experimental PvE mode called Vault Breaker, a roguelike experience that puts Runners on the Cryo Archive of the UESC Marathon. Take on UESC hordes from room to room, solve Vaults, and extract Vault Data to level up Vault Breaker kits or spend them to acquire loot for future runs. Vault Breaker runs from July 21 through August 4 in Marathon, available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: Marathon - Official Vault Breaker Gameplay Overview Trailer

description: Don't miss the Launch Trailer for Meowgic, a co-op fantasy adventure game developed by Lazy Turtle Games. Players will explore the halls of a feline magic school to fight monsters, learn new spells, and collect loot for the next adventure. Meowgic is available now for PC (Steam).
title: Meowgic - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
T.W.I.R.L. gets a creepy new trailer and a release date. Watch the latest T.W.I.R.L. trailer for this upcoming horror game. T.W.I.R.L. will be available on PC, Mac, and Linux via Steam on August 10, 2026. It will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and Nintendo Switch at a later date.

Creep through the throes of youth as a nine-year-old boy in 2006, awakening at 3:00 a.m. while his family is asleep. Slink around his childhood home as some unknown force coaxes him out of bed, pulling him to roam the halls in the dead of night. Feel every pace with the weight of a spectral overseer behind him, compelling him to “T.W.I.R.L.” — whatever that means — with one caveat: Don’t. Tell. Anybody.
title: T.W.I.R.L. - Official Release Date Trailer
